source.snippet: I'm researching ways to manage large volumes of historical business data while keeping storage organized, secure, and accessible when needed. Requirements: Scalability, configurable retention policies, security, tiered storage (not all data on expensive high-performance storage).

problem_statement: Businesses accumulate large volumes of historical records but lack affordable, opinionated software to manage tiered long-term archiving with configurable retention policies and secure retrieval.
target_segment: IT managers and compliance officers at SMBs with growing data retention obligations
notes: Business context clear — this is a compliance/IT purchasing decision. Existing tools (Veritas, Commvault) are enterprise-priced; gap exists for SMB-priced SaaS with simple retention policy UI. Buyer has budget: they reference 'expensive high-performance storage' implying they're already spending on storage.
